title: Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth
abstract: arXiv:2611.31977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network. Recent looped diffusion transformers are trained from scratch, which repeats the full pretraining cost although strong pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers exist. We propose Distill to Loop (Dooop), which distills a pretrained non-looped diffusion transformer into a looped student whose blocks are initialized from the teacher's. We cast distillation as a fixed-point iteration toward the teacher, in which the output after every loop is trained toward the teacher, and each loop is one step of an ordinary differential equation in depth. As a result, one model runs any number of loops at test time without retraining, and the higher-order ODE solvers of diffusion model sampling can be applied along the depth dimension for better results. translated_title: 蒸馏成循环：将预训练扩散Transformer转化为深度可调的循环模型
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer沿着网络深度方向复用一个共享权重的块。尽管已经存在强大的预训练非循环扩散Transformer，但近期的循环扩散Transformer仍是从零开始训练的，这重复了完整的预训练成本。我们提出了Distill to Loop（Dooop），将预训练的非循环扩散Transformer蒸馏成一个循环学生模型，其块由教师模型的块初始化。我们将蒸馏过程建模为朝向教师模型的定点迭代，其中每次循环后的输出都朝向教师模型进行训练，且每次循环相当于深度方向上常微分方程（ODE）的一步。因此，一个模型在测试时可以运行任意次数的循环而无需重新训练，并且扩散模型采样中的高阶ODE求解器可以沿深度维度应用以获得更好的结果。同时，由于循环模型在每次循环后都会产生输出，我们还在……之间构建了循环引导。
tldr: 提出Dooop方法，将预训练的非循环扩散Transformer通过定点迭代蒸馏为循环模型，实现测试时任意可调的循环深度而无需重新训练。
en_tdlr: We propose Dooop, a distillation framework that turns pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers into looped models via fixed-point iteration, enabling arbitrary adjustable loop depth at test time without retraining.
